in_marathi.name: Pranshul
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Shiva's grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pranshul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pranshul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Prasnshu' which means 'the grace of Lord Shiva'. This name is believed to bring blessings of Lord Shiva and is often given to boys as a sign of his divine grace and protection.
